Class ModularSolverParallelTask

java.lang.Object
solvers.linearSystemSolver.ModularSolverParallelTask
All Implemented Interfaces:
Callable<Object>
public class ModularSolverParallelTask extends Object implements Callable<Object>
The ModularSolverParallelTask performs the solution of a residual linear system and part of the result recombination process. It is used to acieve parallelisation of the ModularSolver.
Author:
Michail Makaronidis, 2010

    • ModularSolverParallelTask

      public ModularSolverParallelTask(BigInteger mod, BigInteger M)
      Creates a ModularSolverParallelTask for solving a residual linear system.
      Parameters:
      mod - The prime modulo corresponding to this system
      M - The product of all prime moduli

  • Method Details

    • prepare

      public void prepare(BigRational[][] Amod, BigRational[] b, Set<Integer> rowsToSkip, Set<Integer> columnsToSkip) throws InconsistentLinearSystemException
      Initialises a ModularSolverParallelTask object for solving a residual linear system Ax=b.
      Parameters:
      Amod - The pre-computed residual matrix A
      b - The (initial, non-residual) vector b
      rowsToSkip - The rows of the initial matrix A and the vector b that must be skipped
      columnsToSkip - The columns of the initial matrix A and the vector b that must be skipped
      Throws:
      InconsistentLinearSystemException - if the operation cannot be completed

    • run

      public void run() throws InternalErrorException, InconsistentLinearSystemException
      Solves the residual system using Extended Gaussian Elimination.
      Throws:
      InternalErrorException - Thrown when an unrecoverable internal error is made.
      InconsistentLinearSystemException - Thrown when the solution cannot proceed due to linear system singularities.
